Title: Public Preview: IMDS restriction support in AKS

Body.Content:
Currently, all pods on AKS nodes can access the AKS worker node's Azure Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) endpoint. 

AKS now offers a managed solution that restricts IMDS endpoint access for customer pods. Only AKS system pods and user pods with host network can access IMDS for retrieving information or authentication. 

Learn more.
